# Element Home Remodeling

> Oak wood staircase specialists and general home remodeling contractor serving Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville, Tampa and the surrounding Central Florida area. Stairs (wood, glass, metal, cable) plus kitchen, bathroom, carpentry and painting.

## Company
- Name: Element Home Remodeling (also referred to as EHR Remodeling)
- Flagship service: Oak Wood Staircase
- Service area: Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville, Tampa and surrounding Central Florida
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Insurance: $1,000,000 general liability insured
- Phone: (954) 696-4859 (Bia — Estimates & Scheduling), (954) 826-5786 (Léo — Owner)
- Website: https://ehrremodeling.com

## Services
- Oak Wood Staircase — our signature service, solid oak stairs built and finished on site.
- Stair Remodeling — replacing carpet, treads, risers and dated balustrades with new materials.
- Custom Stairs — staircases in wood, glass, metal or cable, designed around the home.
- Metal Railings — fabricated and powder-coated steel balustrades, modern or traditional.
- Glass Railings — frameless low-iron tempered glass on stainless standoffs.
- Custom Handrails — hand-shaped continuous wood and metal handrails.
- Kitchen Remodeling — full and partial kitchen remodels.
- Bathroom Remodeling — from a full gut to a refresh of fixtures and finishes.
- Carpentry — custom carpentry and trim work.
- Interior Painting — interior painting and stain work.

## Frequently asked questions (stair remodeling)
- Do you build custom staircases in Ocala, FL? Yes — Ocala is one of our core service areas, alongside Orlando, Gainesville and Tampa.
- How long does a stair remodel take? Most remodels (new treads, risers, railings) run 1–2 weeks; a full custom oak staircase built from the subfloor up takes longer.
- What railing materials are offered? Solid oak, frameless glass, powder-coated black metal, or cable railing.
- Are they licensed and insured? Yes — $1,000,000 general liability insured.
- Can they remodel a carpeted staircase? Yes — replacing worn carpet with solid oak treads/risers and updating the balustrade is one of the most requested projects.
- How much does a new staircase cost? Depends on size, materials and scope (remodel vs. full rebuild); estimates are free.
